scope: Unchanged authored model-free synthetic retrieval fixtures. Not independent real-user accuracy, code-execution correctness, dynamic dispatch completeness or production latency.
limits: Class-method import resolution covers direct named methods of top-level JS/TS classes; parameter/local shadows are conservatively skipped. This is not arbitrary dynamic-dispatch resolution.
The extraction cache schema invalidates old AST entries on extraction. Existing projected graphs need an index refresh for the newly resolved edge.

Ranked scope is limited to a narrow explicitly qualified change-request shape and reuses the existing graph dependency/owner traversal. Missing, stale or bounded-out graph data preserves ordinary retrieval; Helm retains its existing policy.

Compound focus requires retrieved support for both clauses of a two-part rationale sharing one named subject. Partial, negated, disjunctive, multi-subject and longer requests remain broad. Support is lexical, not semantic entailment.
Default symbol-links behavior and caps are unchanged. All full-recall figures refer to links enabled on the measured synthetic corpus.
